title: Call to Chaos (Stinky Edition) passes a Unit Immune to Spells by
notes: S #150 Call to Chaos (Stinky Edition)'s switch to Attack passes an enemy Unit Immune to Spells by, as its Freeze did (R4599000, ported from #4649); the fuzz monitor's I21 allows a killerless death in a play that a card that is no Spell cast, its casting card's collected mark (R4863000).

player.title: Call to Chaos (Stinky Edition) respects Immune to Spells
fixes: Call to Chaos (Stinky Edition) no longer switches an enemy Unit Immune to Spells to Attack Position.
